# Elite Orbits

> Elite Orbits is a travel booking platform where customers search and
> compare flights, hotel/villa stays, and self-drive or chauffeur car
> rentals, see transparent pricing, and confirm their booking directly
> with the team over WhatsApp.

## What Elite Orbits offers
- Flight search and booking across routes with transparent, all-in pricing.
- Hotel and stay bookings (hotels, villas, resorts) with per-night pricing.
- Self-drive and chauffeur car rentals by the day.
- Every booking is confirmed by chatting with the Elite Orbits team on WhatsApp.

## Key pages
- Home: https://eliteorbits.com/
- Flights: https://eliteorbits.com/flights/
- Stays: https://eliteorbits.com/stays/
- Car rentals: https://eliteorbits.com/cars/
- About: https://eliteorbits.com/about/
- Reviews: https://eliteorbits.com/reviews/
- FAQ: https://eliteorbits.com/faq/
- Contact: https://eliteorbits.com/contact/
- Booking policy: https://eliteorbits.com/booking-policy/
- Cancellation policy: https://eliteorbits.com/cancellation-policy/

## How booking works
1. Customer browses flights, stays, or cars and sees the live price.
2. Customer clicks "Book Now" (requires a free account).
3. The booking is saved, and WhatsApp opens with the booking reference
   and details pre-filled so the customer can confirm with the Elite
   Orbits team directly.

## Contact
- Support email: support@eliteorbits.com
- WhatsApp and phone: available on the Contact page.
